verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test mode for Runpod: no test API keys, no staging environment, and nothing that separates test runs from production resources or data. The multi-tenant containerized isolation it does document keeps other users out of your data, which is an adjacent security control, not a test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
